description: This file defines the LeaveApplication class and related functions for managing employee leave requests, including validation, notifications, ledger entries, and calendar event generation within an HR management system.

classes.name: LeaveApplication
classes.description: Represents a leave application for an employee, including validation, notification, ledger entry creation, and attendance updates.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns a formatted string for activity feeds related to the leave application.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of the leave application, including employee status, date checks, leave balance, overlaps, and optional leave constraints.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles actions after the leave application is updated, such as notifying the leave approver.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Processes the leave application submission, including validation, attendance update, notifications, and ledger entry creation.

methods.name: before_cancel
methods.description: Prepares the leave application for cancellation by setting status.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions upon cancellation, including ledger adjustments and notifications.

methods.name: validate_applicable_after
methods.description: Checks if the leave application is applicable based on employee joining date and leave type settings.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates date fields for logical correctness and compliance with HR policies.

methods.name: validate_dates_across_allocation
methods.description: Ensures leave application period aligns with leave allocation periods.

methods.name: validate_back_dated_application
methods.description: Prevents backdated leave applications if future allocations exist.

methods.name: update_attendance
methods.description: Updates attendance records based on leave approval.

methods.name: cancel_attendance
methods.description: Cancels attendance entries related to the leave application.

methods.name: validate_salary_processed_days
methods.description: Checks if salary has been processed for the leave period to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: show_block_day_warning
methods.description: Displays warnings if leave overlaps with block dates.

methods.name: validate_block_days
methods.description: Prevents approval on block dates.

methods.name: validate_balance_leaves
methods.description: Ensures employee has sufficient leave balance.

methods.name: validate_leave_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping leave applications.

methods.name: throw_overlap_error
methods.description: Raises an error when leave overlaps are detected.

methods.name: get_total_leaves_on_half_day
methods.description: Calculates total leaves on half-day applications.

methods.name: validate_max_days
methods.description: Ensures leave duration does not exceed maximum allowed.

methods.name: validate_attendance
methods.description: Checks if attendance is already marked for leave days.

methods.name: validate_optional_leave
methods.description: Validates optional leave against holiday lists.

methods.name: set_half_day_date
methods.description: Sets the half-day date if applicable.

methods.name: notify_employee
methods.description: Sends notification to employee about leave status.

methods.name: notify_leave_approver
methods.description: Sends notification to leave approver.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Handles email notifications.

methods.name: create_leave_ledger_entry
methods.description: Creates ledger entries for approved leaves.

methods.name: create_ledger_entry_for_intermediate_allocation_expiry
methods.description: Splits ledger entries to account for expiry of leave allocations.
